long_biography.plain_text:
Born in Tehran and raised in Britain, Marandi studied electrical and electronic engineering before qualifying as a chartered accountant. Work at PwC, Coca-Cola International and Philip Morris preceded his move into entrepreneurship, where he established businesses in distribution, advertising, telecommunications and franchising. Those ventures were followed by investments across European property, hotels, construction and consumer brands.

Today his clearest personally attributable holdings sit in fashion retail. Marandi controls more than half of Precedent Retail Group, the parent that owns at least three-quarters of wedding-apparel company Wed2B. He also owns between a quarter and half of A.S.H.S., the company behind Anya Hindmarch, while the designer holds the voting control. Other disclosed interests include hospitality and real-estate projects, but their values cannot be added to him without ownership and capital-structure detail. This record supports Investor as his relationship to wealth and Fashion & Retail as the strongest identifiable current sector. It does not reveal which of his varied early businesses created most of the original fortune. Marandi also co-founded the charitable foundation bearing his family name; its funds remain separate property.
